The web rebirth function falsifies the whole sentence, tenthGold included. §1t1523s0§.as:2638 opens the rebirth routine; :2644-2648 read 'if(§1t7356s0§(§1t9426s0§) == 8) { §1t9713s0§(§1t9413s0§,100); ... getString(864,[...,"10"]) }' and :2649-2651 'else { §1t9713s0§(§1t9413s0§,25); }'. §1t9413s0§ = 12, which is STAT_HGOLD in the android constant table (StatsManager.as:194). So the web build pays 25 hard-gold per rebirth and 100 on the rebirth that promotes you to the tenth dan — tenthGold=100 exactly, and a 10th-rebirth tier that the ledger says does not exist. :2653-2655 then hard-caps the ladder: 'if(§1t7356s0§(§1t9426s0§) < 9) { §1t9713s0§(§1t9426s0§,1); }' — the dan stat can never exceed 9, i.e. ten rungs ending at 十段. lane_impact: L4 progression: replace RR:201's surface note with four exact cap formulas, ATK/DEF/SPD 1+(lvl+10)*3, MAXHP 10+(lvl+10)*10, MAXCHI 10+(lvl+10)*5, MAXAP 30+(lvl+10)*5, and delete the gear/rebirth explanation of 271.
ledger_text: The "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive (237-point first-run budget makes it impossible in one stat) — resolvable by arithmetic now.
text: REBUILD_READINESS.md:201 says the "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive and that a 237-point first-run budget makes 271 impossible in one stat, then files it as 'resolvable by arithmetic now'. It is not an arithmetic puzzle and it is not gear-inclusive: 271 is the literal hard-coded per-stat ceiling of the WEB build at the level cap. §1t5957s0§.as:3340 reads the character level into _loc2_ and :3344-3346 gate the ATK / DEF / SPD add buttons on 'stat < 1 + (_loc2_ + 10) * 3'. At level 80 that is 1 + 90*3 = 271 EXACTLY. The same block gives the other three ceilings for free: MAXHP < 10 + (level+10)*10 = 910 at L80, MAXCHI < 10 + (level+10)*5 = 460, MAXAP < 30 + (level+10)*5 = 480. Android's numbers are different (5 / 5 / 1 / 1 coefficients, InventoryUI.as:2407-2412) and do NOT produce 271, which is a second confirmation that 271 is a v0.717 web datum. No reconstruction needed, and the 237-point-budget reasoning in the ledger is answering a question the code never asked.
